command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; V=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; C=frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; VF=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py; CF=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py; systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$V"; systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$C"; VP=$(systemctl --user show "$V" -p MainPID --value); CP=$(systemctl --user show "$C" -p MainPID --value); test "$VP" -gt 1; test "$CP" -gt 1; VCMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$VP/cmdline); CCMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$CP/cmdline); printf 'VOICE_PID=%s
CLIENT_PID=%s
VOICE_CMDLINE=%s
CLIENT_CMDLINE=%s
' "$VP" "$CP" "$VCMD" "$CCMD"; case "$VCMD" in *"$VF"*) ;; *) exit 71;; esac; case "$CCMD" in *"$CF"*) ;; *) exit 72;; esac; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl --user show "$V" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p NRestarts -p ExecStart --no-pager; systemctl --user show "$C" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p NRestarts -p ExecStart --no-pager; echo '===HASHES==='; P=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts; sha256sum "$P/voice_final_runtime.py" "$P/voice_full_runtime.py" "$P/omega_runtime.py" "$P/frankenstein_identity_assembly.py" "$P/omega_arm_bus.py" "$P/omega_organ_activity.py" "$P/voice_host_777_live_client.py"; echo '===OMEGA_SELFTEST==='; /home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega selftest; sleep 2; test "$(systemctl --user show "$V" -p MainPID --value)" = "$VP"; test "$(systemctl --user show "$C" -p MainPID --value)" = "$CP"; echo '===ERROR_SCAN==='; journalctl --user -u "$V" -u "$C" --since '2026-09-13 00:53:41' --no-pager -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'traceback|exception|fatal|segfault' && exit 73 || true; echo OMEGA_RUNTIME_POSTREADBACK_PASS
